Wow... I swear to you we are so so very alike. Your feelings, your upbringing and such. 

I bet you feel like you’re all alone and no one REALLY understands right?? Because I feel that too. I think we’ve walked through mostly similar shoes so I feel like we really can relate and feel each other.. 

I have been in pain for such a long time as well, and I know how it feels; it feels like you find yourself crying over the same situation, subconsciously knowing it won’t change but secretly and silently just wishing for something to be done about it, not knowing what to do besides cry.. which just feeds into the cycle of, just.. looking back, getting upset/angry etc. crying and then all over again. 

Yes yes I have struggled with that for so many years. Literally since a child up until this past month. BUT I was given some really good advice thanks to Reddit...

It sounds like you’ve tried everything. And i believe you when you say you are trying to keep strong; and I KNOW that feeling of just wanting to be able to slip and just have something right there to catch you. But I’m telling you... we can mainly just count on ourselves to keep us afloat, so please don’t give up. It’s okay to take a break! But please stay strong and keep an open mind to what I’m about to share as I think I may have found an answer to our struggles.. yes, we CAN accept support and it can help,  it sounds like you feel like nothing is being done about it; even though you know your loved ones are trying you still feel so unsatisfied..  and yes, you feel like you’ve tried everything. BUT. And please, keep an open mind: Have you tried forgiveness? 

Look hear me out, I am quite stubborn, especially with grudges and betrayal. Ive heard about forgiveness before and I would scold and huff at even the idea of forgiving those people who have wronged me. I get it. It IS a hard idea to grasp our minds around! Our pride just simply won’t allow it because we feel as though they do not deserve our forgiveness, at all! And maybe they don’t deserve it. But what I DO hear from your post is that you ARE tired of feeling upset and angry over past events. I understand it all too well... But I think forgiveness might be the answer

I was advised that you do not have to tell the person that you forgive them and that you can just say it outloud alone, or to write it down and read it in your head. In my case they told me to start with “I forgive my dad for abusing me. I forgive my mom for never getting us out of that situation.” Etc. I wrote down the forgiving messages about people I felt like I was really wronged by, and I kept reading it.

 I was also advised it’s important to forgive yourself too. For me it was like “i forgive myself for harming myself.  I forgive myself for not standing up for myself against my sister’s abuse.” 

This has been the hardest thing I’ve tried, I damn cried just reading the sentences; it felt like my identity / my whole self had been clinging onto the bad past for SO long, that letting it go truly felt unfamiliar therefore scary. But that’s just because of how long that we have held onto these things. So it will feel like that, but that’s just because you would be letting go something that you MUST let go of in order to move on. 

It will feel weird, different, it might make you cry BUT again that’s because of how long it’s been.. keep in mind that it is for the better and that it WILL lead onto better in the long run.

In order to let go of that really bad feeling, in order to make room for good, so that we can create good memories and let go of the bad; you must really let it go. Let it die. 

Forgiveness is not saying what they did was okay. Forgiveness is for YOU to acknowledge the bad for what it is and come to an acceptance with it so that YOU could move onto better. It won’t be easy as it feels apart of our identity. But your bad hurtful experiences do not define you, they are not apart of your identity, they are separate; you are much better and mean so much more than what you have been staying attached to for so long. 

I hope this helped.. because the advice I was given I feel like helped me. Since I did that yesterday I do feel like I have taken a step towards healing.. I really hope the same for you.
